text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Perbekalan) (No. 2) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2025

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tiga puluh juta dua ratus enam

puluh tiga ribu ringgit (RM30,263,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan

Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri bagi tahun 2025 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 4,177,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 20,133,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 815,000

Perbelanjaan lain 1,289,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 3,849,000

JUMLAH 30,263,000

Dibuat 12 Disember 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(12); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) (NO. 2) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 47(1)

of the Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Supply) (No. 2) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2025

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding thirty million two hundred sixty three thousand

ringgit (RM30,263,000) from the Self-Employment Social Security Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Self-Employment Social Security Scheme

for the year 2025 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 4,177,000

Supplies and services 20,133,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 815,000

Other expenditures 1,289,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 3,849,000

TOTAL 30,263,000

Made 12 December 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/27/4(12); PN(PU2)744/JLD.4]

SIM CHEE KEONG

Minister of Human Resources
